correctness.rationale: The top-k label classification gives exactly (m)_k vertices of rank k. The norm bound is saturated only at rank n, and nonnegativity makes disjointness equivalent to zero cross term. Thus the known diameter equality cases count to the exact unconditional atom for independent ordered draws with replacement. On the event that both draws are full rank, W is the inner product divided by n². The centered permutation covariance has eigenvalue (Q_n−S_n²/m)/(m−1) on the mean-zero space and vanishes on constants; squaring and taking its trace gives the stated variance. An independent m=4,n=2 hand count gives atom 24/289, conditional mean 9/16 and variance 121/768. In the critical regime the hypergeometric overlap has all falling-factorial moments tending to λ^r, and at each fixed overlap size the two ordered samples of scaled labels converge to independent uniform marks. Tightness of the overlap and full-rank probability 1−O(1/(m−n)) transfer this compound-Poisson limit to the actual draws. The critical zero probability follows separately from the exact no-overlap product, so does not rely on weak convergence at an atom. In the subcritical and supercritical cases, the conditional mean and relative variance give the stated mean-scale limits, using Markov and Chebyshev respectively; the overlap mean bound and the exponential no-overlap bound give the corresponding zero-atom limits.
residual_risks: Moment formulas are conditional on both draws being full rank; no claims for uniform interior points, random edges or dense sequences outside the stated assumptions.
